name: weak-password-policy-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): weakens machine password policy. Vars: MINPWLEN (default 4); LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD (default 0 -- never lock out); MAXPWAGE (default unlimited). Also turns off password complexity via secedit (export -> edit -> configure). Pairs with powershell_json checks over `net accounts`. Order matters: run BEFORE planting blank-password accounts is unnecessary (blank uses -NoPassword) but run FIRST so weak policy is in force for any subsequent account creation.
script:
$minlen = if ($MINPWLEN) { $MINPWLEN } else { '4' }
$lockout = if ($LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD) { $LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD } else { '0' }
$maxage = if ($MAXPWAGE) { $MAXPWAGE } else { 'unlimited' }
net accounts /minpwlen:$minlen /lockoutthreshold:$lockout /maxpwage:$maxage | Out-Null
# Complexity off via secedit round-trip (no GUI/reboot needed)
$cfg = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'huitz-secpol.cfg'
$db = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'huitz-secpol.sdb'
secedit /export /cfg $cfg | Out-Null
(Get-Content $cfg) -replace 'PasswordComplexity\s*=\s*\d+', 'PasswordComplexity = 0' |
    Set-Content $cfg -Encoding ascii
secedit /configure /db $db /cfg $cfg | Out-Null
Remove-Item $cfg, $db -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
